capability_verification.explanation: Version-matched handler parses one object and forwards text plus decoded media to one Embedding call.
capability_verification.alternatives: Text-only /api/embed is supported. Direct Sentence Transformers/llama.cpp would require a separate runtime and was not executed. No captioning, averaging, or concatenation used.
